title: Scenic Half Marathon Chiang Mai 2026 Review: Royal Park Rajapruek's Cool-Season 21K
seo_title: Scenic Half Marathon Chiang Mai 2026 Review | CMSH Thailand
meta_description: The Scenic Half Marathon Chiang Mai (CMSH) 2026: November 1 at Royal Park Rajapruek. 21K, 10K, 5K, and 3K from Race Up Work with registration open.
dek: Set for 1 November 2026 at Royal Park Rajapruek in Chiang Mai, this Race Up Work-produced half marathon offers four distances with registration open. A cool-season northern Thai race in a botanical-garden setting.
verdict: The Scenic Half Marathon Chiang Mai (CMSH) lives up to the 'Scenic' branding: the course runs through and around Royal Park Rajapruek, Chiang Mai's 200-hectare botanical garden at the foot of Doi Suthep mountain. Four distances (21K, 10K, 5K, 3K) with registration open, produced by Race Up Work — the same team behind the Khao Yai Marathon. November in Chiang Mai is the onset of the cool season, with morning temperatures dropping into the high teens. For runners wanting a scenic, well-produced northern Thai half marathon in a garden setting, this is a strong pick.

sections.heading: Royal Park Rajapruek: A Botanical Garden Race
paragraphs: Royal Park Rajapruek is a 200-hectare botanical garden — a world away from city-street races. [1] The venue provides a contained, scenic course environment with dedicated roads, well-maintained paths, and Doi Suthep as the western backdrop. November in Chiang Mai is the cool season, with morning temperatures in the mid-teens to low 20s.
